code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in g for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors = [v for v in counts if v != bg]
    if not colors:
        return g
    fg = max(colors, key=lambda v: counts[v])
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] == fg]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in pts); r1 = max(r for r, c in pts)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in pts); c1 = max(c for r, c in pts)
    # Complete the outer frame of the marked figure.
    for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
        for r in (r0, r1):
            if g[r][c] == bg: g[r][c] = 2
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        for c in (c0, c1):
            if g[r][c] == bg: g[r][c] = 2
    # Short horizontal breaks between marked fragments are also completed.
    # Do this only when the frame itself has breaks; intact patterns stay unchanged.
    frame_broken = any(g[r][c] == bg for r in (r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)) or any(g[r][c] == bg for c in (c0, c1) for r in range(r0, r1 + 1))
    # g now has 2s in frame gaps, so detect the condition from original pixels.
    frame_broken = (any(grid[r][c] == bg for r in (r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)) or
                    any(grid[r][c] == bg for c in (c0, c1) for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)))
    if frame_broken:
        for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
            cols = [c for c in range(c0, c1 + 1) if grid[r][c] == fg]
            for a, b in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
                if 1 < b - a <= 3:
                    for c in range(a + 1, b):
                        if g[r][c] == bg: g[r][c] = 2
    return g
'''
